item.title: Patrick Stewart was thinking about AI ethics years before ChatGPT launched
item.description: The accomplished thespian was well-versed in the humanities, but he was also keen to consider the moral questions surrounding technology. Yesterday, the world lost one of its great thespians. Sir Patrick Stewart, known on stage for his riveting portrayals of Shakespeare’s characters and, more broadly, for his film portrayals of the X-Men’s Professor X, passed away after a short battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia....
